semantics.server_rule: Children identify configured MCP servers by explicit logical identity.

semantics.transport_rule: Process/URL/socket/session is binding/runtime state, not MCP semantic identity.
semantics.inert_rule: Configured MCP definitions are inert until explicit lifecycle/connect operations.
semantics.authority_rule: MCP connectivity or advertisement visibility does not grant invocation/data authority.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself never creates semantic ownership or runtime authority.
